text:
Type: white picture frame with wide mat
Use: displaying a poster, print or photo on a wall; living room, bedroom, home office, hallway
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: white painted frame, off-white mount board, clear front
Colors: white, warm off-white mat, light grey insert
Shape: tall portrait rectangle with a slim flat frame, generous mat border around a large picture window, quiet on the wall, large but light
Feel: airy, clean, soft, calm
Goes with: white or pastel walls, light wood, botanical or watercolor prints; Scandinavian, minimalist or coastal rooms
